description:
Make `jit profile diff` and `jit profile apply --dry-run` report the projection conflict that `jit profile apply` refuses on.

## Background

Found while testing c780514e's 14c08f51 on an unseeded copy of this repository. `diff` and `apply --dry-run` report `would_apply` and exit 0. `apply` exits 4 with `PROFILE_CONFLICT`, naming `docs/reference/rules-and-gates.md: stale`: applying new rules makes a configured rules-and-gates projection stale, and neither preview catches it. `docs/reference/profiles.md` says a rehearsal runs the same planning and validation as its `apply`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A selection that `apply` refuses for a stale projection is reported as a conflict by `diff` and by `apply --dry-run`.
title: Profile previews report the projection conflict apply refuses on
